reason: Version 1 retains 73 failed fits and fails one condition point. Its best failed diagnostic estimates are near truth but stop before the declared smooth gradient criterion; the hard per-bin cap makes the likelihood nonsmooth.
base_fit: Keep the three registered bounded L-BFGS-B starts and all successful smooth interior candidates.
fallback_trigger: Only if no smooth candidate passes the original convergence, finite, interior and gradient checks.

fallback.start: Lowest finite loss among the three bounded L-BFGS-B results

acceptance: Converged finite interior fallback, plus no lower mean NLL by more than 1e-10 over the 26 directions in {-1,0,1}^3 excluding zero at log-parameter step sizes 1e-4 and 1e-5. This is a declared finite local check, not a proof of a global optimum.
scope: Apply prospectively to the version-2 allocation and a full new 100-dataset-per-point simulation. Do not relabel version-1 failed fits.
